scope: All 169 shared recipes. Private user recipes were not accessed or changed.
review_method: Downloaded and decoded every available image; manually reviewed all 142 images that loaded in labeled contact sheets, opening uncertain cases at full resolution. All 12 temporarily rate-limited images passed a slower retry. Checked unused library assets and 16 free-photo candidates. This is a content/availability audit; historical image licenses and cooked recipe outcomes are not newly certified.
